title: PowerPoint: upload skills to a Brand Kit for use by Copilot in PowerPoint
summary: Hold: Microsoft Support already documents Brand Kit skills, including their upload and use, while the briefing leaves important behaviour and governance unresolved. Brand Kit documentation also names a Premium Copilot licence requirement and distinguishes publishing from organization-wide sharing; the briefing should reflect those facts without changing the roadmap's recorded status.
